sections.Description:
Experience the terrifying forces in Hawkins, Indiana that turn this small town “upside down” with supernatural elements, strange sightings, and government secrets.

The gameplay focuses on unlocking the hidden meanings of supernatural events occurring in and around the town, including the appearance of a girl known as “Eleven” with telekinetic abilities. The ball is wild as Mike, Lucas, Dustin, Will, Joyce, and Police Chief Jim Hopper help Eleven close the dimensional gate.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Demogorgon Projection: Featuring the first ever video projector that displays images and animations directly on the playfield, creating dramatic interactions with gameplay action.
- Battle the Demogorgon: A unique center ramp that doubles as a screen and leads the player into a direct battle with the Demogorgon.
- Telekinetic Powers: Shoot the Left Ramp to lock balls vertically at the new Eleven themed “telekinetic” magnetic ball lock.
